subject: Nimble is looking for a short-term developer

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Nimble is looking for a short-term developer
parts:
Hi everyone,

The Nimble team at UC Berkeley has some funding for a short-term and/or part-time software development role. We are looking for some combination of skills in C++, advanced R, and ecological statistical modeling. Depending on the exact skill set, we can tailor the work to be done from among several ongoing projects. We are particularly interested in work within the next four months but can also consider longer time frames. At this point we do not have a formal job advertisement but wanted to spread the word as soon as possible. Please reply directly to us (Perry and Chris, but not the entire nimble-users list!) with a short note and CV or resume if you would like to learn more. Unfortunately this role will be limited to US citizens. Please forward to others who might be interested.

Perry, Chris, and the Nimble team
